verdict.rationale: Honcho documents workspaces as top-level containers that isolate different applications or environments. Its CLI can also start a full local stack (API, deriver, Postgres, Redis) via Docker, which gives an isolated environment separate from production data. There is no documented dedicated sandbox or test mode, so isolation depends on the user setting up separate workspaces or a local instance. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox/test environment or test-mode API keys, explicit docs on separating test from production data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Workspaces - Top-level containers that isolate different applications or environments
